semantics.read_rule: Condition check is read-only unless separately declared.
semantics.transition_rule: Notify/dispatch semantics are based on explicit false→true/threshold/rearm policy.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Persistent true condition does not repeatedly create duplicate semantic notifications unless recurrence is explicit.
semantics.state_rule: Last evaluated/last satisfied/rearm state is explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Condition satisfaction does not grant downstream authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
